qualifiedClaims: Character heading explicitly givesキ andくわだてる; the planning sense lists企業 among its compound examples.
Together with the separateき‐ぎょう compound heading, preserved full metadata and既存業ギョウ, this establishesキ allocation in企業, not a mere kana-substring inference.

sources.heading: くわ‐だ・てる〔くは‐〕【企てる】
sources.inspection: Entire actual article nodes0/1,204/589characters, with publisher/headings/grammatical class/definitions/examples and separate語誌. No encyclopedia material treated as a definition.
qualifiedClaims: Exact spelling and heading agree withくわだてる; the source classifies a transitive ichidan verb, not godan-mu.
Planning, trying a plan and intending to execute it support the article's activityを pattern and ordinary ichidan forms.
The fuller historical usage note describes serious/weighty and bad undertakings; the draft says can sound deliberate or weighty and can suggest plotting, not always malicious or always neutral.
The frozen complete JMdict family separately marks the tiptoe sense archaic. Neither that flag nor historical forms make the planning verb obsolete.
Frozen JMdict explicitly recognizes business undertakings. The new business-planning and unspecified-plan examples are ordinary original sentences, not quotations or claims of corpus attestation.
sources.limits: No frequency ranking, universal good/bad distinction, guarantee of successful execution, classical conjugation course or etymological teaching. The printed boundaryくわだ.てる describes written okurigana; the verb's ichidan forms do not treatてる as an independently added lexical verb.

publishers: Shogakukan, 精選版 日本国語大辞典
sources.heading: たくら・む【▽企む】
sources.inspection: Entire actual article nodes0/1,208/249characters; exact heading, godan-mu class and qualified usage note.
qualifiedClaims: Exact企むたくらむ agrees with the full rawたくら.む entry. It is not a contraction or alternative conjugation of企てる.
Daijisen emphasizes bad plans; 日本国語大辞典 says often used for such plans, supporting a tendency rather than a universal ban on neutral/playful contexts.
The independent frozen JMdict usual-kana flag qualifies spelling, not the validity or age of the pronunciation.
A plain recognition row preserves this real verb without an extra support article or curated kanji-reading key. Kana-first teaching is an editorial scope choice, not proof that written企む is invalid.
sources.limits: The▽ notation is not interpreted without a notation guide. No claim of an obsolete pronunciation or a measured frequency/register ranking. Harmful examples from source dictionaries are not reproduced as teaching scenarios.

qualifiedClaims: Exactき‐ぎょう heading and organizational-business sense agree with existing primary企業きぎょう, noun, independently sourced N3.
The only changed teaching passage adds企 navigation at the existing component introduction; primary reading, title, word level, business meaning,会社 guard and業 link stay unchanged.

日本国語大辞典 also records a historical starting-an-enterpriseする sense with an1882 example. The reused card explicitly teaches the enterprise noun, not exhaustive historical senses; do not generalize its scoped contrast into a claim that no historical企業 ever means起業.

retrievalLimits.parserDependency: BeautifulSoup was unavailable on an initial optional probe. No package was installed; a small standard-library HTML parser supplied the needed article boundaries.
retrievalLimits.independence: Coordinator source qualification only. Future reviewers receive exact provenance and source access; cached coordinator evidence is not described as each reviewer's independent upstream retrieval.
retrievalLimits.copyright: Raw pages remain outside Git/runtime. This record paraphrases bounded relevant claims and supplies exact headings/URLs/hashes, not a redistributed dictionary.
